landing.stat_misinfo_desc: Okuggyamu okusingawo ebyogerwa ebitali bituufu mu bitundu byaffe.
landing.stat_hw_desc: Babadde n'ebikozesebwa eby'okukebera n'okuzuula tewali yintaneeti.

landing.stat_clinics_desc: Nga tuweereza enkola ey'okukola tewali yintaneeti mu bitundu by'oku kyalo.

malaria-2026-05.title: Okweyongera kwa Malaria — Emambuka ga Uganda
malaria-2026-05.description: Okulinnya kw'omusujja gwa malaria kuzuuliddwa mu disitulikiti z'e Gulu, Lira, ne Kitgum oluvannyuma lw'enkuba ey'amaanyi eyatonnye mu Gwokutaano. Amadwaliro galaga okulinnya kwa 34% okw'abalwadde abakebeddwa ne RDT. Minisitule y'Obulamu ekubiriza abantu okusula mu butimba ne okujjanjaba mu ssaawa 24.

cholera-2026-05.title: Okubalukawo kwa Kolerera — Disitulikiti y'e Kasese
cholera-2026-05.description: Ekitongole kya UVRI kikakasizza okubalukawo kwa kolerera olw'amazzi amacaafu okumpi n'entiko z'ensembereze ze Rwenzori. Abalwadde 47 n'emifu 2 be baamaze okutegeezebwako. Ebigo bya ORS centri birina okukola ku ddwaliro lya Kasese General Hospital. Abatuuze bakubirizibwa okufumba amazzi g'okunywa.

mpox-2026-04.title: Mpox (Mpox y'Enkima) — Nakaseke ne Luweero
mpox-2026-04.description: Minisitule y'Obulamu ekakasizza abalwadde 12 ab'omusujja gwa Mpox mu disitulikiti z'e Nakaseke ne Luweero. Abasawo batandise okukola okukebera n'okugema n'eddagala lya JYNNEOS. Abantu bakubirizibwa okwewala okukwata ku bisolo ebirwadde n'okutegeeza mangu ku bubonero.

measles-2026-03.title: Amalubula ga Mumpumpu — Ekitundu ky'e Karamoja
measles-2026-03.description: Okugemwa okw'olukale okuli wansi mu disitulikiti z'e Moroto, Nakapiripirit, ne Amudat kuvuddeko mumpumpu okubalukawo. Abalwadde 89 be bategeezebwako n'emifu 6 naddala mu baana abali wansi w'emyaka 5. Entegeka z'okugema rutin ziriwo. Abazadde basaanidde okutwala abaana mu ddwaliro amangu.

typhoid-2026-03.title: Ekibinja kya Musujja gw'Omubyenda — Biseera by'e Kampala
typhoid-2026-03.description: Okusaasaana kw'obulwadde bwa musujja gw'omubyenda kuzuuliddwa mu batunda emmere mu Bwaise, Kamwokya, ne Katanga. Abalwadde 23 be bakakasiddwa. Okukebera kulaga nti obulwadde bulemwa eddagala lya ciprofloxacin ku 60%. Minisitule esaba okulya emmere eyidde obulungi n'okunaaba mu ngalo.

rabies-2026-02.title: Okufa kw'Omusujja gw'Embwa (Rabies) — Lyantonde ne Rakai
rabies-2026-02.description: Abantu basatu bafudde rabies oluvannyuma lw'okulumwa embwa mu disitulikiti z'e Lyantonde ne Rakai. Minisitule y'Obulamu etandise enkola y'okugema embwa zonna. Buli alumwa ekisolo asaanidde okunaaba amangwago ekiwundu n'okufuna eddagala lya PEP mu ddwaliro.

covid-2026-01.title: Kiberera kya COVID-19 XEC — Ekiseera Ekitono
covid-2026-01.description: Okulinnya okutono kw'obulwadde bwa COVID-19 okuliko ekika kya XEC kuzuuliddwa mu Kampala ne Wakiso. Abalwadde 340 be bategeezebwako mu January 2026. Okukebera kuli mu maaso. Abantu abaliko obunafu bakubirizibwa okufuna eddagala ery'okwongerako (booster doses).

tb-2026-jan.title: Kafuba (Tuberculosis) — Ripoota ya Minisitule ya Bulimu
tb-2026-jan.description: Uganda yafuna abalwadde ba kafuba 84,000 mu 2025, okweyongerako kwa 8% okuva mu 2024. Abalwadde ba kafuba atayise ddagala (MDR-TB) bali 3.4%. Minisitule ekubiriza okumaliriza eddagala lyonna okumala emyezi 6. Okujjanjaba kafuba kwa bwereere mu madwaliro ga gavumenti.
